text: Too late. You're famous. Let's rewind.
It starts with a real moment. Our pipeline spots the stories taking over the internet.
We choose together, from wherever we are. Recognizable. Funny. Playable. This one becomes: don't get caught.
We build the game and plan the launch together. Dodge the camera. Hide in the crowd. Get caught, laugh, and try again. One simple idea, ready to share.
Twelve hours in, we're live. A funny clip, one link, and a challenge: can your friends beat your score?
Here's our ambition for day one. A million content views. Twenty thousand game visits. Players bringing more players.
By day two, imagine our game becoming the news. The story has a new chapter.
Too Soon Games. Make the moment playable.
